about: the watchlist seed writes and returns only what the schema accepts and reports every row it refuses; pattern intake needs a license on the MIT-compatible list; register and retire refuse to write over a watchlist they cannot read (DECISIONS-LOG 2026-10-11)

mutants.replace: /** A table row with a source id that did not become an entry, and each reason why. */
mutants.why: a no-op: a doc comment reworded, nothing a test can see
the rule before 2026-10-11: anything but exactly `unverified` permits intake, so `unverified (read as AGPL-3.0 …)` and `AGPL-3.0` do
a listed license is matched ignoring case, as SPDX identifiers are
surrounding space does not change a license's standing
